memory_safety.description: Unsafe block — review the concrete invariants for raw pointers, FFI, aliasing, initialization, and lifetimes
slice::from_raw_parts requires a valid, aligned allocation and a sound length
slice::from_raw_parts_mut additionally requires exclusive mutable access
transmute can create invalid values or violate layout and lifetime invariants
Raw-pointer operation — verify validity, alignment, overlap, initialization, and bounds
from_raw retakes ownership and can cause double-free or allocator/refcount corruption
unwrap_unchecked is undefined behavior when the value is None or Err
Vec::set_len requires every newly exposed element to be initialized
Vec::from_raw_parts requires exact allocator, capacity, alignment, and initialization invariants
from_utf8_unchecked creates an invalid str if the input is not valid UTF-8

ffi.description: C FFI boundary — validate ABI, ownership, lifetime, unwinding, and thread-safety assumptions
CStr::from_ptr requires a non-null, valid, NUL-terminated pointer with a sufficient lifetime
CString::from_raw must receive exactly one pointer produced by CString::into_raw
Unbounded C string operation reachable through FFI — verify destination capacity and termination

integer_safety.description: Unchecked arithmetic has caller-enforced overflow preconditions and can cause undefined behavior
Narrowing numeric cast truncates silently — validate range or use TryFrom/TryInto
Unchecked indexing is undefined behavior when the index is out of bounds
Manual allocation — verify checked size arithmetic, alignment, null handling, initialization, and matching deallocation

crypto.description: MD5 is unsuitable for passwords, signatures, collision resistance, or adversarial integrity checks
SHA-1 is collision-broken and unsuitable for signatures or adversarial integrity checks
Predictably seeded RNG — do not use deterministic seeds for tokens, keys, nonces, or reset secrets
Statically seeded RNG may make security-sensitive output predictable
AES-ECB is deterministic and leaks plaintext structure — use an authenticated mode such as AES-GCM

sql_injection.description: SQLx query text built with format! — keep SQL structure fixed and bind values
Diesel raw SQL built with format! — use typed query APIs or bind parameters
Database query assembled with format! — bind values instead of interpolating them

command_injection.description: Shell execution — trace every command string and argument to its trust boundary
Potentially attacker-controlled executable selection — enforce an exact allowlist

ssrf.description: reqwest GET uses a likely externally supplied URL — validate scheme, resolved address, port, and redirects
HTTP client uses a likely externally supplied URL — require a destination allowlist and redirect revalidation
Hyper URI is built from a likely untrusted string — validate the effective destination before connecting

path_traversal.description: Filesystem operation uses a likely external path — canonicalize against a trusted base and enforce containment
File open uses a likely external path — enforce trusted-base containment and symlink policy

open_redirect.description: Redirect uses a likely external destination — allowlist normalized local destinations
Location header uses a likely external destination — validate it before redirecting

output_injection.description: Dynamically formatted raw HTML response — contextually encode every untrusted value
Dynamically formatted Rocket RawHtml response — HTML-escape untrusted values
Unchecked HeaderValue construction bypasses CR/LF and header-byte validation

template_injection.description: Runtime Tera template source may be attacker-controlled — render only trusted templates
Runtime template compilation may consume attacker-controlled template source

deserialization.description: Unbounded binary deserialization can cause excessive allocation, recursion, or custom-visitor side effects
Deserialize untrusted input only with strict body, depth, collection, and type limits
